hypothesis: A strict same-run immutable prefix delta can make continuous live-canary review reproducible by separating resolved execution economics, provisional open-lifecycle paths, technical coverage, causal provider-signal maturity, and one-blocker missed-opportunity evidence without creating strategy or execution authority.
decision: Retain the running v25 strategy and extend the report-only prefix-delta workflow with provider-symbol and one-blocker horizon maturity. Raw overlapping opportunity counts are now separated from independent/non-overlapping cost-clearing evidence, and cumulative provider evaluation counts cannot move backward. The 24.66-minute prefix added no eligible provider evaluation, fill, close, fee, funding, or resolved PnL. The HYPE breakout 5m_not_breakout blocker gained five non-overlapping resolved five-minute paths but only one independent cost-clearing close/MFE/robust-MFE observation. That single shared market path is descriptive and does not justify removing the blocker, changing a route, or pooling the same HYPE move across provider mappings. No restart, drain, order, close, resize, risk, exit-policy, or promotion change is authorized.
falsifier: The monitoring method is falsified by accepting mismatched run/profile identity, backward rows or cumulative provider evaluations, overwriting evidence, pooling overlapping paths as independent observations, pooling the same market path across providers, success-shaping a missing close, arithmetic mismatch, changed or missing current-revision evidence, execution authority, or runtime strategy mutation. The economic decision is updated by materially larger independent after-cost blocker evidence, newly resolved venue lifecycles, a new technical-gap identity, or unexplained lifecycle disappearance.
limitations: The measured window is one 24.66-minute prefix of one running process and is not an independent market sample.
The single independent HYPE blocker path is too small for a blocker or routing decision and may share the same underlying move with other provider mappings.
Provider path outcomes do not model an order, fill, queue, slippage, fees, funding, capital contention, liquidation, or realized PnL.
Open marks, ignored-exit paths, and profit-lock states remain provisional until venue close.
The ten additional pressure-metric nulls come from the already-loaded old implementation and do not test the staged clock repair.
No live route, process, order, position, stop, target, allocation, drain, protection, or runtime strategy changed in this revision.
